message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | # | Rule | Details | |---|------|---------| | 1 | **Objective** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by collecting cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round. | | 2 | **Setup** | • Shuffle the Uno deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down to form the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card (Draw Two, Reverse, Skip, Wild, or Wild Draw Four), treat it as if it had been played by the dealer. | | 3 | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | 4 | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card from your hand that matches the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top card on the discard pile. If you can’t play, you must draw a card. | | 5 | **Special Cards** | • **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – You choose the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you’re penalized.) | | 6 | **Drawing a Card** | • If you can’t play, draw one card from the draw pile.
• If that card can be played immediately, you may do so. Otherwise, your turn ends. | | 7 | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you fail to call UNO and another player catches you before the next turn starts, you must draw two penalty cards. | | 8 | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points based on the cards remaining in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Draw Two, Reverse, Skip = 20 points.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points. | | 9 | **Game End** | The game continues until a player reaches the target score (usually 500). | --- ### Quick Play Tips 1. **Keep a mix of colors** in your hand to avoid being stuck. 2. **Save Wild Draw Four** for when you’re sure you have no matching color. 3. **Watch opponents’ “UNO” calls**—they’re a good indicator of how close they are to winning. 4. **Use Reverse strategically** to change the flow of play, especially when you’re about to finish. Enjoy playing Uno!
